alphaInterpretation: Single prespecified target under the stated unverified assumptions; this is a research proposal parameter, not an approved production threshold.
featureInterpretation: Minimal saved score-model and original-quote projection. It does not contain full npxG, personnel or match conditions, and does not establish full conditioning sufficiency.
contextOmissionInterpretation: Total allowance for the target and weighted-neighbor full-context versus reduced-feature conditioning gaps, not only a target gap.
numericalTailInterpretation: Total allowance for target and weighted-neighbor source arithmetic and forecast tails; calculator rounding is separately enclosed.
